sessions.title: The family switchboard
sessions.focus: Avery inventories the calls, appointments, and decisions that route through her.
sessions.possible_movement: She distinguishes tasks only she can do from tasks she automatically absorbs.
sessions.carry_forward: Bring one recent week of examples.

sessions.title: Anger before the phone rings
sessions.focus: A missed sibling callback triggers a disproportionate argument.
sessions.possible_movement: Avery identifies anger as information about overload, not a verdict on the relationship.

sessions.title: The request without the case
sessions.focus: She rehearses asking a sibling to own medication pickup every Thursday.
sessions.possible_movement: Avery notices how much evidence she wants to present before making a simple request.
sessions.carry_forward: Send a brief request without overexplaining.

sessions.title: Help in someone else's style
sessions.focus: The sibling follows through but organizes the task differently.
sessions.possible_movement: Avery experiments with accepting adequate help rather than reclaiming control.
sessions.carry_forward: Track urges to redo the task.

sessions.title: What cannot be organized
sessions.focus: A quiet moment with her father evokes sadness and fear.
sessions.possible_movement: She stays with grief without moving immediately to the next appointment.
sessions.carry_forward: Choose one low-demand ritual of connection.

sessions.title: The canceled plan
sessions.focus: A health change disrupts Avery's first evening out in weeks.
sessions.possible_movement: The session separates a genuine emergency from the belief that rest is futile.
sessions.carry_forward: Reschedule rather than abandon the plan.

sessions.title: The spreadsheet no one asked for
sessions.focus: Avery prepares a detailed care ledger, then realizes it may obscure the request she needs to make.
sessions.possible_movement: She converts the ledger into three concrete responsibilities while keeping the underlying resentment discussable.
sessions.carry_forward: Bring the shorter proposal to the family meeting.

sessions.title: A family meeting with edges
sessions.focus: A long-form session reconstructs a family meeting about time, money, transportation, and their father's preferences.
sessions.possible_movement: Avery holds one limit, overfunctions in another moment, and leaves uncertain whether the agreement will last.
sessions.carry_forward: Send a plain-language summary and wait before correcting anyone's method.

sessions.title: The hospital call at work
sessions.focus: A non-emergency medical call arrives during a staffing problem at the library.
sessions.possible_movement: Avery delegates the family follow-up but later retakes two tasks after receiving incomplete information.
sessions.carry_forward: Identify what made delegation tolerable and what pulled her back in.

sessions.title: His lucid afternoon
sessions.focus: A quiet visit with her father includes humor, irritation, and a direct question about what he wants.
sessions.possible_movement: Avery hears a preference that conflicts with her own idea of the safest plan and does not resolve it immediately.
sessions.carry_forward: Record the preference without turning it into a final decision.

sessions.title: Money and the old scorecard
sessions.focus: The siblings revisit unequal expenses and older stories about who has always been dependable.
sessions.possible_movement: Avery names the current financial request without proving a lifelong case against either sibling.
sessions.carry_forward: Separate reimbursement decisions from judgments about character.

sessions.title: The week she took everything back
sessions.focus: A sibling misses a pickup and Avery resumes nearly every task for six days.
sessions.possible_movement: The setback is examined as information about thresholds and backup plans rather than evidence that sharing cannot work.
sessions.carry_forward: Restore one responsibility instead of redesigning the whole system.

sessions.title: An evening that survives a phone call
sessions.focus: Avery keeps dinner plans while her brother handles a manageable change in their father's schedule.
sessions.possible_movement: She notices guilt, checks once, and returns attention to her partner without requiring the evening to feel relaxed.
sessions.carry_forward: Repeat one protected plan with a clear emergency exception.

sessions.title: Care without disappearance
sessions.focus: They review the remaining strain, grief, family agreements, and supports that are still inconsistent.
sessions.possible_movement: Avery defines care as participation within limits and identifies early signs that she is becoming the switchboard again.
sessions.carry_forward: Use the plan as a living agreement and return to care as needed.
